description: This source file defines a SpeechPipeline for handling live speech recognition using Apple's AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It manages audio input, transcribes speech with a SpeechTranscriber, and produces recognized SpeechSegments, with error handling and authorization logic.

classes.name: SpeechSegment
classes.description: Immutable data structure representing a segment of recognized speech, including text and finality status.

classes.name: SpeechPipelineError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible errors during speech recognition pipeline, such as authorization denial or unavailable modules.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: Actor managing the live speech recognition workflow, including audio input, transcription, and result streaming.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the speech recognition pipeline with specified locale and etiquette, returning a stream of SpeechSegments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates the speech recognition session, stopping audio and transcription tasks.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Processes and converts audio buffers to the required format and feeds them into the analyzer.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and requests user authorization for speech recognition if not already granted.
